text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call: GPU inference pool 'east-prod-gpu' experiencing rapid queue growth and throttling. Autoscaler not reacting. Severity: P1. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/prod/gpu-queue?run=4781234567

lucy (oncall): Ack. I'm on it. Can someone post current queue length and HPA status?

marco (sre): queue ~12k reqs across pods, avg queue growth +40% in last 10m. HPA shows currentReplicas=8, desiredReplicas=8, maxReplicas=8. custom metrics API returning 502 from prometheus-adapter.

anya (eng-runtime): Confirming. Logs from prometheus-adapter show scrape errors to /metrics/custom: "write tcp: connection reset by peer" starting ~03:28 UTC. Might be prometheus itself hitting backlog.

nora (infra): GKE nodepool still at min nodes, autoscaler isn't adding because HPA isn't requesting. We can force scale nodepool but that'll take ~4-6m to join.

sam (customer-success): We have multiple customers reporting 503s and slow responses, ticket volume rising. Notifying top-20 customers with status update.

lucy (oncall): Live mitigation plan: 1) Increase worker replicas manually to relieve queue. 2) Restart prometheus-adapter to restore HPA metrics. 3) If adapter not healthy, manual nodepool scale as emergency. Who can run the restart?

marco (sre): I'll do restart now. Command: ```kubectl -n monitoring rollout restart deployment prometheus-adapter```

devbot: Deploybot: restart triggered for prometheus-adapter deployment by marco at 03:35 UTC. CI checks OK, rolling restart starting.

marco (sre): Adapter pod logs (tail): ```2026-03-15T03:34:52Z error: upstream read timeout, 503 returning to HPA query```

anya (eng-runtime): While restart rolls, let's also bump worker replicas to drain queue: ```kubectl -n inference scale deployment gpu-worker --replicas=16``` Doing it now.

nora (infra): Manual nodepool scale as fallback: ```gcloud container clusters resize prod-cluster --node-pool=gpu-pool --num-nodes=12 --zone=us-east1-b``` Use only if adapter restart + replica bump don't bring queue down in 6m.

lucy (oncall): Doing customer impact note: "We're investigating a GPU autoscaling issue causing request throttling; engineers are applying mitigations. No data loss observed; response delays and 503s likely." Sam pls post interim update.

sam (customer-success): Posted to affected customers and public status page. Adding "next update in 15 minutes or when mitigated."

marco (sre): prometheus-adapter pods are back up but still returning 500 for custom metrics queries; digging into Prometheus scrape backlog. ```kubectl -n monitoring logs deploy/prometheus -c prometheus | tail -n 50``` shows series backlog and OOMKill on one replica ~03:22.

anya (eng-runtime): OOM on prometheus is bad — it explains adapter errors. Which replica crashed? We have 3 replicas, one crashed and the remaining got overloaded. Recommend scaling prometheus horizontally and increasing retention temporarily.

nora (infra): I'm provisioning an additional prometheus replica and increasing PV CPU limit. ```kubectl -n monitoring scale deployment prometheus --replicas=4``` applying now.

marco (sre): Meanwhile HPA still unchanged because adapter returns errors. We need to avoid further throttling: enabling emergency fallback HPA that uses CPU metric for a short window. Patch HPA to CPU-based target using `kubectl patch`? Risky but low: it will allow autoscaler to request more pods.

anya (eng-runtime): I can apply a temporary patch to gpu-worker-HPA to switch to CPU target 60% and maxReplicas=32. Command: ```kubectl patch hpa gpu-worker -n inference --type='json' -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/metrics","value":[{"type":"Resource","resource":{"name":"cpu","target":{"type":"Utilization","averageUtilization":60}}}]},{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/maxReplicas","value":32}]'``` Proceeding.

lucy (oncall): Proceeded. HPA patched to CPU fallback and maxReplicas increased. Monitor.

devbot: Autoscaler event: HPA gpu-worker: desired=20 -> scaling up.

marco (sre): Queue length starting to decline: 12k -> 7.8k in 4m. Latency lowering. Good sign. Prometheus replica 4 started, adapter error rate dropping.

nora (infra): Nodepool still at original size for now. We avoided heavy infra ops. If queue persists >5k after 10m, we will scale nodes.

sam (customer-success): Notifying customers: "Mitigation in progress; throughput improving. Expect next update in 10m."

lucy (oncall): Handoff: I'm handing to anya for the midnight -> 04:00 UTC shift. Lucy -> Anya. Full summary: adapter errors due to Prometheus OOM, adapter queries failing prevented HPA from scaling, GPU queue grew causing throttling and 503s. Mitigation: restart adapter, scale prometheus, temporary CPU-based HPA fallback, and manual replica bump. Ongoing: monitor queue, revert HPA patch when adapter stable, analyze root cause of Prometheus OOM.

anya (eng-runtime): Taking over. I'll watch metrics for 30m and coordinate RCA. @marco please capture logs and heap dump from prometheus instance that OOM'd.

marco (sre): Captured heap and event logs, pushing to artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/prod/incidents/4781234567/prom-heap-03-22.tar.gz

sam (customer-success): I'll update customers with resolution steps and ETA for full postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident P1 status updated -> mitigated (partial) at 03:52 UTC. Follow-up: postmortem and action items assigned.

lucy (oncall): Closing handoff note. Anya taking ownership. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
